name: Kavren Tallgrass
source_profile: ● Kavren Tallgrass (CG) is the leader of the River Wardens. Kavren objects to ranchers fencing traditional grazing corridors and diverting water from shared streams. He has begun tearing down fences and driving cattle from disputed meadows.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 66 (source excerpt; may be partial)
